import type { HTMLAttributes } from "react";

export function Kbd({ className = "", ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>) { return <kbd className={`co-inline-flex co-min-w-6 co-items-center co-justify-center co-rounded co-border co-border-black/20 co-bg-black/5 co-px-1.5 co-py-0.5 co-font-mono co-text-xs ${className}`.trim()} {...props} />; }
